summary: United States 12 Month Oil Fund, LP filed an 8-K noting that The Marygold Companies (TMC), sole shareholder of its general partner USCF, agreed with Madison Dearborn Partners for TMC to go private in an all-cash transaction. No price, premium or stake was disclosed. The deal requires TMC stockholder approval, regulatory clearances and change-of-control consents, and is expected to close in the first half of 2027; TMC shares will delist from NYSE. Watch for consent timing and any impact on the fund's GP arrangements.
